integrity: The proof uses the published recurrence estimates and product-poset antichain lemma from Klazar--Luca and independently repairs the one step their paper identifies as failing for base 3. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves only an upper bound and density zero for base-3 Keith numbers; it does not determine infinitude or a sharp asymptotic. The main residual originality risk is an unindexed later note on ternary Keith numbers.
title: Ternary Keith numbers have density zero
